svg.text: Make two, one a mirror image of the other. RHS 70 x 30 x 5,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 70 face upright; the 30 depth runs away from the trunk.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Length 175 along the trunk-side face; the inner end is cut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 30 deg so it lies flat on the spine face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TIG weld a 4 mm cap on the outer end. Drill a 6 drain hole in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom face near each end (rain water must run out).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 6.5 holes through the trunk-side face only, 53 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 138 from the inner end, 25 up from the bottom, for the screws.
